A més, compta amb una planta altell de 32,78 m2 no registrat.En aquesta planta, trobareu un passadís, dues oficines, sales polivalents, sala reunions i dos lavabos.

inv.desc_en:
REF: 6567996

Attention! If you are looking for a safe and profitable investment in the Les Corts neighborhood, we have an excellent opportunity for you. At Inmoolaya, we are offering a profitable commercial space that has a privileged location in an area with a high residential and business density.

This commercial premises for sale Barcelona is located in the medical center of the area and is fully operational. With 351m2 built, divided into two floors, this place is ideal for any investor looking for long-term profitability.

The ground floor has 318.95m2 built, useful 255.16m2. It has a lobby and steps, nine offices and three toilets, which allows a large space for any type of business.

In addition, it has a mezzanine floor of 32.78m2 not registered. On this floor, you will find a corridor, two offices, multipurpose rooms, a meeting room and two toilets.

Sale price: €824,000

Annual rent: €41,200

IBL: in charge of the tenant.

Community expenses: Paid by the tenant, without spills.

Contract: 15 years, 5 years mandatory.

Income review: CPI with a maximum of 5%.

If you are looking for a safe and profitable investment in a privileged area of Les Corts, look no further. Contact us today and get more information about this commercial property in profitability! At Inmoolaya, we are committed to offering the best options for our clients.
